question.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$T=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 & -10 \\ 0 & 4 & 0 & -5 \\ 1 & 3 & 2 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & 3 & -25\end{aligned}]$
question.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(T) & ={t}_{11}{C}_{11}+{t}_{12}{C}_{12}+{t}_{13}{C}_{13}+{t}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =0\cdot {C}_{11}+0\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}-10\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =-10{C}_{14} \\  & =-10\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & ∗ & -10 \\ 0 & 4 & 0 & ∗ \\ 1 & 3 & 2 & ∗ \\ 1 & 2 & 3 & ∗\end{aligned}| \\  & =-10(-1)^{1+4}|\begin{aligned}0 & 4 & 0 \\ 1 & 3 & 2 \\ 1 & 2 & 3\end{aligned}| \\  & =10(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 2 & 3\end{aligned}|-4\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 1 & 3\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}|) \\  & =10(0-4(1\cdot 3-1\cdot 2)+0) \\  & =10\cdot (-4) \\  & =-40\end{aligned}
$$
